audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 58.33% win rate, and the TL;DR opens with 'His dash beats your poke rhythm' — Olaf has no dash anywhere in his kit.
audit.why: Olaf's only approach tool is Undertow (9s flat, 1000 range) which slows but does not move him. A 950-range Karma with a 12s tether beats a walking bruiser until Ragnarok is up.
audit.corrected: diffRating 4/10, carryRating 6/10, both difficulty lines reworded, and the fabricated dash removed from tldr and report[0].t.
sources: kit: Olaf Q/W/E/R — no dash flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart disagreed with the whys text sitting next to it — the chart gave Olaf levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while the whys said 'you out-poke him with almost no risk', 'your peak' and 'you reclaim the lane'.
audit.why: Karma dominates 1 through 5 against a dashless, sustain-less bruiser; Ragnarok at 6 is his one owned stage; first item favours Karma again; 2+ items flattens to a skill window as his lifesteal and true damage catch up.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Olaf, Karma, Skill in matched pairs across both layers, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claim Ragnarok blanks 'your W root and E slow'. Karma's E is a shield and move-speed buff with no slow — the slow is on her Q.
audit.why: This matters for what the player saves: the E shield still works inside Ragnarok and is the disengage, while the W root is the ability that becomes worthless. Told the current way, a player holds the wrong button.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.you[1] and the mid text now say Ragnarok blanks disables, name the 100/90/80s duration, and tell the player to spend E to disengage rather than hold it.

audit.why: Undertow refunds its cooldown when Olaf picks the axe back up, and breakdown.cooldowns already tells the player to stand on the pickup spot to deny the reset. That is the right punishable window.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your bullying peak: chain Q into RQ Soulflare to shove him off the wave and tax plates behind Inspire's move speed, and without lifesteal items yet he can't answer the chip at all. Don't be standing there when he pops R: disengage with Inspire, wait it out, then re-root with W and resume poking once it ends.
